question: Republic of Maldives which is also called Maldive Islands is an independent island country in the north-central:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indian Ocean.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **The Maldives, in the full Republic of Maldives, is an independent island country in the north-central Indian Ocean.**
 
• It** consists of a chain of about 1,200 small coral islands** and sandbanks, grouped in clusters, or atolls.
 
• The Maldives is one of those few places on earth where** one can spot the gorgeous whale sharks, **the world’s biggest fish, all year round.
